integrity.limitations: Automorphism and quotient assertions follow from the exhibited order-five linear map and tame Riemann–Hurwitz, without claiming an explicit plane equation for the quotient.
integrity.reproducibility: Exact exhaustive binary linear-algebra and group enumeration, plus four-chart Gröbner and a degree-five singular witness.

scientific_limitations: The result concerns smooth embedded (3,4) complete intersections through all fifteen points of projective three-space over the binary field, not all space-filling curves.
The cyclic group is the full ground-field projective stabilizer, not a claim about the full abstract or geometric automorphism group.
The earlier fixed-cubic 144-smooth-section count is not asserted to be original; the new result is orbit transitivity and automorphism/quotient geometry.
Search and source inspection cannot certify absolute historical priority.
title: One projective class of minimal space-filling complete-intersection curves over \(\mathbb F_2\)
